_comment: Local-only dataset config for `npm run data:fetch:local`. Each entry uses `localFile` (repo-relative path) instead of `resourceUuid`, so a manually-downloaded centre listing can be loaded without the data.gov.in API key. The same normaliser, district/state filters and snapshot writer apply as the network path.

datasets.name: karnataka_cmkky_training_centres
datasets.title: Training Center details under CMKKY (Chamarajanagar Kaushalya Karnataka Yojana)
